title: Kirby Problem 1.70
exact_target: Does sharpness of the slice-Bennequin bound imply quasipositivity? Does equality of Seifert and slice genera distinguish strong quasipositivity among quasipositive links? Also ask whether a ribbon surface attaining the bound is isotopic to a complex-curve piece.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2729 (KP-1.70). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman, eds., \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295, American Mathematical Society (2026), Problem 1.70 and its remarks; Chapters 1 and 2 for the stated conventions.
